heroHeadline: Day 88: CJNG Africa Meth Labs Confirmed — U.S. AFRICOM Warns Congress; El Sapo Hunt Day 88; 21 Days to World Cup
heroSubtitle: Day 88 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG AFRICA LABS (May 20–21): U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) warned Congress that CJNG has established clandestine methamphetamine labs in Africa — South Africa is the primary hub (4 Mexican nationals detained at a site near Swarttruggens; 12 cartel labs identified across the continent, 11 intercepted). La Jornada confirmed May 21: 'General estadunidense liga a narcos mexicanos a laboratorios en África.' Together with the Chile meth hub (May 17: 35-year sentences sought for 844kg meth for Australian distribution), this documents a CJNG transnational manufacturing arc from South America to sub-Saharan Africa — independent of the core Manzanillo/Jalisco fentanyl operation and resilient to 88 days of decapitation pressure. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 88: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. His capture or elimination is the single most critical unresolved variable for Plan Kukulkan. PLAN KUKULKAN — 21 DAYS: Twenty-one days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 group-stage matches) continues under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. LAGOS DE MORENO CREMATORIO (ONGOING): FGE Jalisco forensics continue at the active CJNG crematory discovered May 17–18 — 16+ burning pits with calcined remains; linked to El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14). 60 bags of human remains found simultaneously at El Salto. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 12: Twelve days since El Chucky arrest (May 9) — no successor named; port under Navy-SEMAR surveillance. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 88): Ongoing — no charges yet. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno crematory linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized.
